verdict.rationale: Alacritty offers IPC through `alacritty msg`, and `alacritty msg create-window` can be scripted to open several windows from one instance. It explicitly ships no tabs or splits and leaves layout to a window manager or multiplexer. A one-command project workspace therefore depends on external tools such as tmux or a tiling WM. Missing for 10: declarative session/startup definitions in config, window or pane layout definitions, built-in tabs/splits, documented per-window command/cwd scripting, hands-on corroboration.
